title: Independent review of school therapy requirements research
status: Pass for research and proposed bounded specification; no unresolved review findings
scope: Evidence-linked requirements for schools and therapists, using SLP as a planning example with OT/PT and assistant distinctions. Review does not establish production readiness or jurisdiction-specific compliance.

checks.evidence: Discovery scope uses schools and therapists; SLP is expressly a worked example. OBR01/02 and the discipline checklist separate SLP/SLPA, OT/OTA and PT/PTA requirements; state and district remain open.

LC01/02 identify expired initial terms and unverified renewals; LC03/04/05 identify district solicitations rather than awarded Amergis contracts or nationwide rules. Vendor capabilities are not asserted as tested integrations.

Independently opened Bristol solicitation and DCPS solicitation. Downloaded DCPS amendment with validated system TLS after web-tool open failed. Confirmed district-specific modality, conflicting documentation thresholds/deadlines and named district systems. HHS school-record FAQ and indexed IDEA personnel rule support the stated conditionality.
J05/J06, OBR03/05/06 and VR09 keep clinical delivery, IEP eligibility/goals/minutes, attestations and missed-service remedies with qualified people and the authorized school process.

Initial scope keeps clinical/IEP content in district-designated systems. OBR07/08/09 require disclosure authority, purpose/assignment scope and relationship-based FERPA/HIPAA classification. Opaque references are explicitly still potentially protected data.

LCR06, OBR12, VR04 and J07 distinguish worked time, delivered service and customer billing; invoice rejection does not silently suppress payroll review. J08 and VR06 require exact-payload financial approval.

checks.topic: Draft field presence and transition prerequisites
checks.evidence: Required-at-create lists now govern initial presence; consent and submission approval evidence are nullable/deferred until required by the relevant transition. ASHA workload reference resolves to integrations V05.

Missing identity or fresh verification remains INCOMPLETE; interval expiry produces EXPIRED plus assignment HOLD; unresolved assistant scope is not a qualified rejection. Billing-rule conflict stays DRAFT. Stale financial approval follows owner-directed correction/re-freeze. All scenario state labels resolve.

All 43 requirement source references and journey/object/scenario links resolve. Eight requirements have textual acceptance criteria but no dedicated scenario; linked scenarios are explicitly partial. The bounded domain excludes multi-session/multi-school routing, assistant placement, clinical records and teletherapy delivery.

Ran check_scenarios.py on 26 scenario specifications, four Decimal financial fixtures and eight unmeasured metrics. It passed fixture shape, references, arithmetic, interval and group-duration consistency. The checker explicitly reports that no product acceptance tests, vendor conformance or live validation were performed.
Root corrected compact field/command decoding and structured validation text rendering. This is source/DOM-level review; no rendered browser or live application behavior is established.

checks.topic: Domain structure, ownership and command semantics
checks.evidence: Independent domain reviewer confirmed all nine declared state graphs are reachable, each nonterminal can reach a terminal, and 50 transition commands join uniquely. Reviewed authoritative records, credential/worksite scope, permissions, exact/current approvals, atomic reservations and idempotency. Cross-file reviewer re-read the corrected readiness, time/payroll, reconfirmation and command-envelope fields. This validates the proposed design structure only.

findings.issue: Legacy RN domain and scenarios contradicted the selected schools/therapists market.
findings.resolution: Replaced with school-therapy scope, SLP example, OT/PT distinctions, district-authorized modality and explicit bounded work-block design.

findings.issue: Initial required-field declarations demanded signed consent and recruiter approval before legitimate DRAFT records could exist.
findings.resolution: Added per-object required_at_create rules and deferred/nullable evidence with transition-specific prerequisites.

findings.issue: Domain ASHA workload reference incorrectly pointed to V07 (CMS).
findings.resolution: Corrected to phase5 integrations source V05.

findings.issue: Several expected scenario states skipped domain guards or used a different expiry meaning.
findings.resolution: SC05/07/19 now preserve INCOMPLETE; SC06 uses EXPIRED; SC26 stays DRAFT until billing rules resolve; SC21 describes owner-controlled correction and re-freezing without a premature state assertion.

findings.issue: SC21 allowed a policy exception for financial agent self-approval contrary to the pilot authority model.
findings.resolution: Removed the exception; exact new approval requires an authorized human financial approver.

findings.issue: Report builder expected expanded field dictionaries and rendered structured validation text as a string.
findings.resolution: Root added compact-format decoding and structured rendering.

findings.issue: Payroll batch review needs an unambiguous state after a time revision is exported; PAY_READY corrections need a safe superseding path.
findings.resolution: DS-C30 accepts PAY_READY or EXPORTED lines uniquely allocated to the same batch; DS-C29 allows owner-controlled void/supersession of unallocated PAY_READY revisions while transferring all work claims. Exported/issued corrections remain linked adjustments.

findings.issue: Runtime command UUID and DS-Cxx command-definition identifier need distinct fields.
findings.resolution: Runtime command_id remains a UUID; command_type identifies one registered DS-Cxx transition or declared non-transition operation. All operations use the audited envelope.

findings.issue: Reconfirmation from HOLD must reacquire fenced worker and slot reservations atomically.
findings.resolution: DS-C20 requires atomic reacquisition/validation of worker and slot locks with fencing before reconfirmation from HOLD.

findings.issue: Dispatch must explicitly check approval expiry, revocation, current approver authority and effective policy.
findings.resolution: The dispatch envelope requires current, unrevoked approval and currently authorized approver under the applicable policy; exact version/payload binding remains mandatory.

findings.issue: Worksite-specific readiness needs a required explicit worksite reference and exact assignment match; shared district policy alone is insufficient.
findings.resolution: DS-O06 now requires same-tenant/client worksite_id, explicitly matching the assignment school, in addition to worker, policy and interval.

limitations: No selected state, district, employment model, executed customer contract or operating vendor agreement has been validated.
No interviews, live student data, authenticated portals, vendor writes or product acceptance execution occurred in this review.
Public source spot checks are selective; they do not establish completeness of all legal, procurement or clinical requirements.
The domain model is a bounded staffing coordination design, not a full IEP, clinical delivery, multi-school scheduling or reimbursement specification.

Eight dedicated scenario-design gaps remain explicitly tracked: LCR03, LCR14, OBR04, OBR09, OBR13, VR02, VR11 and VR14. Existing linked scenarios do not establish exhaustive requirement or transition coverage.
No measured automation benefit, security effectiveness, legal completeness, profitability or product readiness follows from schema, graph or arithmetic consistency.
review_method: Independent source/applicability and cross-artifact review by school_requirements_review, with specialist graph/command/authority review by local_domain_spec/domain_review. Findings were returned to file owners and corrected in place.
research_completion_boundary: The research pack may be delivered with its explicit open pilot decisions and test-design gaps. Actual implementation, vendor testing, state/district validation and live operating approval are future work, not prerequisites for completing this research task.
